Dear Madam
I wish I could promise a ready admittance to My English Servant into the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), but I am afraid that sending it to me would only involve an almost endless waiting.

Some stories I have had by me for two years, and I think yours deserves a better fate, I wish the [SPCK](../others.html#40) would take it, I can’t understand their principles, for I am sure there are two or three stories in their last set of no use to anybody!

yours truly

C M Yonge
